tensorrt.notInstalledWindows: TensorRT-LLM belum terpasang. Pemasangan akan menyalakan WSL bila perlu, menyiapkan distribusi WSL milik Atomic Chat dengan Docker dan NVIDIA Container Toolkit di dalamnya, lalu mengunduh image mesin.

plan.reboot: Windows mungkin perlu dimulai ulang setelah WSL dinyalakan. Setelah dimulai ulang, buka Atomic Chat: pemasangan berlanjut dengan sendirinya.
plan.wslDisk: Disk: {{required}} untuk distribusi WSL Atomic Chat di {{path}}; tersedia {{free}} di sana.
plan.wslDiskNoFree: Disk: {{required}} untuk distribusi WSL Atomic Chat di {{path}}.
plan.wslDiskNoPath: Disk: dibutuhkan {{required}} untuk distribusi WSL Atomic Chat; tersedia {{free}} di sana.
plan.wslDiskUnknown: Disk: {{required}} untuk distribusi WSL Atomic Chat. Lokasi dan ruang kosong tidak dilaporkan.

uac.waiting: Menunggu Anda menyetujui permintaan administrator Windows (UAC) untuk menyalakan WSL…
uac.manual: Windows tidak dapat menampilkan permintaan administrator untuk Atomic Chat di sini. Buka terminal sebagai administrator, jalankan perintah ini, mulai ulang komputer bila diminta, lalu tekan Periksa lagi:
uac.running: Windows is installing WSL. This takes several minutes and shows no window of its own; Atomic Chat continues by itself when it finishes.

hostStep.running: Installing Docker and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit; this takes a few minutes, and the installation continues by itself.

reboot.title: Mulai ulang komputer
reboot.body: WSL sudah dinyalakan, dan Windows perlu dimulai ulang untuk menyelesaikannya. Setelah dimulai ulang, buka Atomic Chat: pemasangan berlanjut dengan sendirinya, tanpa meminta persetujuan lagi.

phaseWindows.preparing-environment: Menyiapkan distribusi WSL Atomic Chat dan memeriksa bahwa GPU Anda terlihat

bar.hostStep: Approve the system password prompt. After that, Docker and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit are installed; this can take a few minutes, and the installation continues by itself.
bar.hostStepWindows: Approve the Windows administrator prompt (UAC). After that, Windows downloads and installs WSL; this takes several minutes with no window of its own, and the installation continues by itself.
bar.reboot: WSL is turned on. Restart Windows to finish; after the restart, open Atomic Chat and the installation continues by itself.
bar.relogin: You were added to the docker group. Sign out and sign back in for it to take effect; then open Atomic Chat and the installation continues by itself.
bar.actionFailed: Could not do it from here ({{error}}). Do it yourself; the installation continues afterwards.
